scripts.version:sync: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const tag=execSync('git describe --tags --exact-match 2>/dev/null || git describe --tags 2>/dev/null || echo v1.0.0').toString().trim().replace(/^v/, '');console.log('Syncing version to',tag);execSync('npm version '+tag+' --no-git-tag-version',{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.copy:backend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join(process.cwd(),'..','dist','jarvis-backend');const dst=path.join(process.cwd(),'dist','jarvis-backend');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);console.log('Copied backend to',dst)}else{console.error('Backend not found at',src);process.exit(1)}"
scripts.electron:build: npm run version:sync && vite build && npm run copy:backend && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run version:sync && vite build && npm run copy:backend && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run version:sync && vite build && npm run copy:backend && electron-builder --linux
scripts.electron:build:ci: npm run version:sync && vite build && npm run copy:backend && electron-builder --mac --publish=never
